title: The projective-line calculation before purity
statement:
Let $N\geq1$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme on which $N$ is invertible. Here Noetherian means having a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S$ with projection $q:P\to S$. Work on small ordinary etale sites and their unbounded derived categories of constant-ring $A$-module sheaves. Define $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T$ and $A_T(-1)=\mathcal Hom_{A_T}(A_T(1),A_T)$ for every $T$ over $S$. On the two standard charts with $t=x_1/x_0$, define $\mathcal O_P(1)$ by generators $e_0=t^{-1}e_1$. Let $c:A_P\to A_P(1)[2]$ be the Kummer first Chern class of $\mathcal O_P(1)$, obtained from the Kummer connecting homomorphism and derived scalar extension from $\mathbf Z/N$ to $A$. Put $K=A_S(-1)[-2]$. Define $h:K\to Rq_*A_P$ as the adjoint under $q^{-1}\dashv Rq_*$ of the composite $q^{-1}K\cong q^{-1}K\otimes_A^L A_P\xrightarrow{1\otimes c}q^{-1}K\otimes_A^L A_P(1)[2]\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}}A_P$, using twist pullback and evaluation. Write $1:A_S\to Rq_*A_P$ for the adjunction unit. Then

$$
(1,h):A_S\oplus A_S(-1)[-2]\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*A_P
$$

is an isomorphism. For every morphism $g:S'\to S$, the corresponding projective-line square and ordinary-etale proper exchange identify the pullback of this isomorphism with the same construction over $S'$.

proof.text: Use [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction] to obtain the normalized positive-twist decomposition and its actual Chern class on the Noetherian base S. Apply [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-untwist] to this biproduct isomorphism to obtain precisely the inverse-twist map (1,h).

For arbitrary g:Sprime->S, invertibility of N pulls back. Apply [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-base-change] to obtain the actual class cprime and both component squares. The biproduct universal property combines them into the required square for (1,h).

The source comparison is invertible because additive inverse image preserves binary biproducts and both summand comparisons are isomorphisms. The exchange is invertible by [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-exchange-iso]. Hence the left side of the square is invertible; cancel the invertible source comparison to show (1,hprime) invertible. This works for arbitrary Sprime.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $q:P=\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, with $S$ Noetherian.
Let $h$ be the Kummer first Chern class of $\mathcal O_P(1)$.
Then

$$
(1,h):A_S\oplus A_S(-1)[-2]\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*A_P
$$

is an isomorphism, compatible with arbitrary change of $S$.

proof.text:
For $\mathbf Z/n$-coefficients, the map is globally
defined by the unit and the Cartier class of infinity in
[lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. On a geometric fibre,
[thm-sc-proper-cohomology] gives cohomology only in
degrees $0,2$, each free of rank one; the genus is zero.
In its Kummer description, the degree-two map is
$\operatorname{Pic}(\mathbf P^1)/n\to H^2(\mathbf P^1,\mu_n)$,
and the class of $\mathcal O(1)$, of degree one, generates.
Thus $(1,h)$ is an isomorphism on every geometric fibre.
By [cor-weil-pbc-geometric-fiber-finite], [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative]
it is an isomorphism on $S$. Both defining components
commute with base change, so the isomorphism does too. For
general $A$, tensor this isomorphism over $\mathbf Z/n$
with $A$ and use
[lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection].

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1Decomposition (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) :
    ∃ c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
        (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S
        ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
            hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom) c ∧
      IsIso (p1DecompositionMap A N hN hA S hS c) ∧
      ∀ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (g : S' ⟶ S),
        ∃ c' : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S') ⟶
            (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S'))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
          ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S'
            ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S').appTop.hom N) ▸
              (((map_natCast g.appTop.hom N) ▸ hS.map g.appTop.hom).map
                (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S').appTop.hom)) c' ∧
          IsIso (p1DecompositionMap A N hN hA S'
            ((map_natCast g.appTop.hom N) ▸ hS.map g.appTop.hom) c') ∧
          (ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map (p1DecompositionMap A N hN hA S hS c) ≫
              ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A g (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S)) ≫
              (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map
                (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) g)).hom =
            p1DecompositionSourceMap A N hN hA g hS ≫
              p1DecompositionMap A N hN hA S'
                ((map_natCast g.appTop.hom N) ▸ hS.map g.appTop.hom) c'
